label: Presentation seen
why: Appendix A asks the operator to record which presentation was seen, not merely to confirm the setting

label: Time green reached
why: Field How To 14.5 requires the time, and 14.2 makes the settling interval run from it

label: Time recording began
why: Field How To 14.5 requires the time significant recording began

label: Time mission closed
why: Appendix B asks for the time the mission was closed in TMI

match: Run count matches what was driven
label: Run count on disk
why: Field How To 23.2 asks for the count, and Appendix B B3 checks it against what was driven

label: SBET filename
why: Office How To 6 distinguishes the plain and _frame filenames, so the name itself is the record

label: Registration number
why: Office How To 16 and 27: sbet_<date>_reg_#### is how the registration is identified later
